policy.name: Utterances retain fillers and repetitions; word metrics exclude listed fillers
policy.automatic_boundary_rule: Sentence boundaries with guarded coordinate clauses requiring their own subject; subordinate clauses and coordinated phrases stay attached
policy.fillers: uh, um, uhm, hmm, hm, mm, mhm, huh, oh and spelling variants removed only for word metrics; all retained for total utterances
policy.repetition: Retain all transcript repetitions; do not infer or remove stutters or retraces
policy.limitations: Predicted boundaries and surface words only; no clinical certification, audio review or morphology

notes: Previous and revised boundaries scored under the same filler exclusion policy.
Filler words and filler-only utterances retained in boundary comparisons and total utterances.
MLU excludes listed fillers and filler-only utterances; repetitions retained.
Rater cells split at explicit terminal punctuation and line breaks, including lowercase continuations.
Boundary statistics use only exactly aligned adjacent word pairs; gap coverage reported.
Corrected software reference scope: Corrected transcripts with the same clause-based splitter as the uncorrected pipeline; source turns mapped by word alignment
CLAN input and output hashes verified during import. Corrected references use the returned CLAN run; uncorrected same-input checks use the saved official CLAN run.
Software calculator agreement on shared text is reported separately from raw versus corrected transcript agreement.
Descriptive comparisons on this dataset; no held-out validation or parameter fitting.
